plain: Using force or threats to make people obey.

webster.text: That has power to restrain, particularly by moral force, as of law or authority.

example.quote: If the states solemnly declare they will not comply, does not this imply a determination not to permit the exercise of the coercive power ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 28, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
